generate_longform_transcription: generate long-form audio transcription with timestamps using Whisper model features
detect_language_from_audio: detect spoken language from log-mel audio input features using Whisper model
extract_token_timestamps: extract token-level timestamps from cross-attention weights using dynamic time warping
apply_dynamic_time_warping: measure similarity between audio and token sequences using dynamic time warping algorithm
pad_sequences_to_max_length: pad multiple audio segment sequences to the same maximum length for batching
